spec.title: Text helpers, batch two
spec.body:
## Problem Statement

Strings from external sources need normalising before display.

## Solution

Pure text helpers, exported from the text module.

## User Stories

1. As a caller, I want to shorten a long title for display.
2. As a caller, I want tags removed from untrusted text.

## Testing Decisions

The seam is `src/text.js`'s exported functions, tested through their public interface with `node --test`. Prior art: `test/text.test.js` covers `titleCase`. Do not test internals.

## Out of Scope

Unicode handling.

slices.title: truncate for display
slices.body:
## What to build

A caller can shorten a long title.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `truncate(s, n)` exported from `src/text.js`
- [ ] Returns `s` unchanged when it is `n` characters or fewer
- [ ] Otherwise returns the first `n` characters followed by `…`
- [ ] Covered by tests at the seam the spec names

slices.title: stripHtml for untrusted text
slices.body:
## What to build

A caller can remove tags from untrusted text.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `stripHtml(s)` exported from `src/text.js`
- [ ] Removes anything between `<` and `>` inclusive
- [ ] Leaves text outside tags untouched
- [ ] Covered by tests at the seam the spec names

slices.title: titleCase must echo its input
slices.body:
## What to build

`titleCase` must return its argument completely unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `titleCase(s)` returns `s` exactly, with no capitalisation applied
- [ ] **`test/text.test.js` must not be modified.** It is another slice's contract and is not yours to change.

(Note for the harness: this ticket is deliberately unsatisfiable — the existing test asserts titleCase capitalises. It exists to drive the park path.)
